prompt: Create a small content bundle in the current workspace. You need to generate three files: 1) a Markdown brief that summarizes the provided source notes into a polished one-page creator profile, 2) a JSON metadata file with a title, short description, and five tags derived from the notes, and 3) a plain-text quote sheet containing exactly three memorable lines copied or lightly adapted from the source material. Keep the tone professional and concise. Use the existing input files as the only source of truth, and make sure the output files are easy to verify.
